product.title: Oakridge® Shingles
product.description: Oakridge® laminated shingles provide premium protection and impressive curb appeal. A full double layer in the nailing zone gives Oakridge® Shingles greater integrity and better holding power compared to shingles with single layer wide nail zones. The warm, inviting look in popular colors provides a step-up from traditional three-tab shingles. Oakridge® shingles are rated Class 3 for Impact Resistance and may qualify for a homeowner insurance discount. Shingles are algae resistant to help control growth of algae and discoloration.
features: Full double layer in the nailing zone
